card.name: Informal this/these before a described noun
card.fires_on: Demonstrative 'this' or 'these' used informally to introduce something new ("we have this polar bear jawbone"), and degree or intensifier words such as 'big' or 'most interesting' just before a noun. Found in general web prose and quotations.

modes.label: Introducing 'this/these'
modes.description: 'This' or 'these' used as a casual introducer after a verb like have, was, create or is.
modes.example: “We have<< this>> polar bear jawbone from the Sval

modes.label: Degree or praise word
modes.description: An intensifying adjective, often after 'most' or 'this', that comes before a noun.
modes.example: It was this<< big>> around," he says, making a circle

card.plain: It marks casual storytelling words like "this big" or "we have this" that lead into a description of something.
